data.name: Azmura
data.gender_notes: Azmura is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'azama' meaning 'to be determined, to be steadfast, to be resolute'. Azmura embodies the strength and determination of a woman who remains unwavering in her convictions. The name Azmura carries the meaning “Determined, resolute, steadfast” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Azmura usually hope their child will grow to embody determined, resolute, steadfast and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Azmura belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Determined, resolute, steadfast.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azmura total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عزمورة
in_arabic.long_meaning: عزمورة هي اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ومعناه الجمال والأنوثة والحب، ويُشتق من الجذر العربي عزم الذي يعني القوة والdecision والإرادة، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة البقرة، وتحمل هذا الاسم معنىً روحياً عميقاً في الإسلام، وهو ي象ز الجمال الداخلي والقوة الروحية

in_urdu.name: عزمورہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزمورہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو براہ راست قرآن پاک سے متاثر ہے، اس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور محبت، اور یہ عربی زبان کے جڑ عزم سے لیا گیا ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قوت اور ارادہ، یہ نام برصغیر پاک و ہند میں بھی بکثرت استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अज़मुरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अज़मुरा एक अरबी नाम है जो कुरान से प्रभावित है, इसका अर्थ है सुंदरता और प्रेम, और यह अरबी भाषा के मूल عزم से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और संकल्प, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी बहुत उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: عظموره
in_pashto.long_meaning: عظموره د عربي نوم دی چې له قران sharif څخه اغیزه اخیستی، دا معنی لري ښکلا او مینه، او دا د عربي ژبې د ریښې عزم څخه اخیستل شوی چې معنی یې ده قوت او اراده، دا نوم په افغانستان او پښتو نړۍ کې هم ډیر کارول کېږي

data.cultural_impact: The name Azmura is rooted in the rich Arabic language and represents a characteristic valued greatly in many cultures, particularly within the Islamic world. In a time where the notion of standing firm in one's beliefs and persevering through hardships is more important than ever, the name Azmura emphasizes the importance of strength, resilience, and determination, making it an empowering choice for a young girl.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Azmura carries deep spiritual significance as it is derived from the root 'azama' which can be linked to the concept of 'tawakkul' - total trust and reliance on God. In Islam, being steadfast and determined is not only an external virtue but also an internal armor that shields us from inner turmoil and doubt, allowing us to remain steadfast in our faith and beliefs. The name Azmura, therefore, serves as a reminder to remain steadfast and rely on God in all situations, ultimately nurturing a strong spiritual foundation.
